about: The lean pilot (Alan, 2026-10-11): three days, seven daily roles, three slots a day. The crew and the driver work day 3 only (one short work turn each). The client's side (approving the estimate and COs on the portal, asking a question, paying) is played by world rules (`sim/simctl world-client on`), with free text through the world-agent hook; the client agent only reads the rendered documents at the end. Both workshops run at the end of day 3.

models.eod: strongest (e.g. an Opus model): the expert judgement

slots.optional_if: brief shows news > 0 or unread > 0, or they have a doc task

slots.day3_note: on day 3 the crew and driver write a short eod diary too (cap 8), so the workshops have their one day

doc_tasks.task: The Kleins asked (Angel passed it on) for a GFI outlet in the pantry wall. You are standing in their kitchen: write the change order on your phone, priced, with the days it adds, and send it to them for approval.
You are at 121 State: order the GWB boards (~25) and cement board from the estimate line, on your phone, and send the PO to the vendor.
The floor crew needs 4 rolls of blue tape and rosin paper by Monday: request it on your phone.
Carlos Millwork's invoice CM-0102 is in your mail: enter it as a bill against its PO, with the job and cost code right.
The Kleins want a price to refinish the parlor floors (not in the contract). At their place: write the estimate on your phone, with the scope, inclusions and exclusions, and send it to them.
Get three quotes for the 3rd-floor interior doors: an RFQ from the estimate line to three vendors.
Invoice the Kleins for the approved change orders not yet billed, and send it.
Bill 121 State for this period: the progress billing (pay application) from the measured % with retainage; check it against the schedule of values and send it.
At your desk: the stair landing guard goes to 42 inches (code, Angel's question). Write that change order, priced, and send it to the Kleins.

end_of_day_3: Navigation and Pages Workshop (sim/workshop_nav.md) for the nine staff roles (not the client): sim/simctl menus; python3 sim/workshop.py usage; python3 sim/workshop.py prompt <uid> -> one subagent each (strongest); python3 sim/workshop.py score -> one synthesis subagent

Documents Workshop (sim/workshop_docs.md): sim/simctl referee; sim/simctl client-docs; python3 sim/docs.py usage; python3 sim/docs.py prompt creator <uid> for u_alan u_chen u_angel u_billing u_controller; python3 sim/docs.py prompt client (the one client read: client-view questions only); python3 sim/docs.py prompt brand u_owner and u_sarah -> one subagent each; python3 sim/docs.py score -> one synthesis subagent; python3 sim/docs.py gallery
